Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

== Title ==
<span lang="ja">Ｒ２をやられた！</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-218o-PSA.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">１フォース消費して、宇宙船の操縦ドロイドかナビコンの破壊を試みる。運命数を引く。運命数＞１ならば、宇宙船に配備し、その宇宙船の航行速度は０になる。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">操縦ドロイドが断末魔の叫びを上げた。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title:''' They Got R2!

'''Card text:''' Use 1 Force to attempt to destroy a starship's astromech droid or nav computer. Draw destiny. If it exceeds 1, deploy on the starship. That ship's hyperspeed becomes 0.

'''Lore:''' The astromech droid gave a dying scream.

== Statistics ==
* '''Destiny:''' 5

Remaining printed symbols and statistics await verification.<ref name="jp-face" />
